land_catalog.name: War of the Philippines TCG Lands

land.name: Manila
land.desc: Urban command center. Generates +2 Dominion and +2 Kalayaan.
land.lore: Manila is a crossroads of commerce, resistance, and command at the heart of the archipelago.

land.name: Pasig River
land.desc: Maritime lane. Generates +1 Dominion and supports water movement.
land.lore: The Pasig links communities and carries the pressure of the city toward the bay.

land.name: San Agustin Church
land.desc: Sanctuary. Generates +1 Dominion and heals stationed units at turn end.
land.lore: Sacred ground becomes a refuge when the surrounding city is shaken by war.

land.name: Palawan
land.desc: Island fortress. Generates +2 Dominion and grants stationed units +2 DEF.
land.lore: Palawan's long coast and hidden routes make it a natural fortress between seas.
